text: 1.Applicant must be a non-Chinese citizen 2.Applicants must be in good health 3.Applicant must have the equivalent education of the high school graduates of the People’s Republic of China, generally above the age of 18. (If he’s less than 18 years old, the student needs to submit the notarial certificate by his guardian in Beijing, otherwise will not be accepted.) 4.Applicant should have certain Chinese communication skills. 5.HSK level 5 or above
